key_reasoning.reason: Touches the LiteLLM budget provider adapter, the LLM factory, the proxy router, the enterprise loader, the budget resolution service and the provider-neutral BudgetRuntimeProviderResult contract (body_overrides removed). A new shared constant module, customer_header.py, centralises the x-litellm-customer-id header.

11 files changed per diffstat (7 source, 4 test; 503 insertions and 433 deletions), which maps to XL on the diffstat file-count scale. Most of the churn is test rewrites, and the source changes are small removal and substitution edits.
